GRAND

A residence among the stars

Scroll

Two hundred and thirty-eight thousand miles from Earth, time slows. The Selene Grand is not a hotel. It is a vantage point — a place from which to reconsider what matters. Where the silence is absolute and the view irreversible. We do not offer amenities. We offer altitude.

Accommodation

The Residences

Three estates · Mare Tranquillitatis

I
Suite · I

The Tranquility Suite

Named for the mare below, Tranquility occupies the northeastern corner of the third pavilion. Earth hangs permanently in its window — not a painting, not a screen. The silence here is geological.

From $480,000 / night
II
Suite · II

The Serenity Wing

A private pavilion of four interconnected chambers, each facing a different quadrant of the lunar horizon. Intended for those who require not just solitude, but scale. Seven thousand square feet at one-sixth gravity.

From $1,200,000 / night
III
Residence · III

The Apollo Residence

The most elevated accommodation on the lunar surface. A glass-domed private rotunda at the apex of the structure, with an unobstructed 360° view of the regolith and the cosmos beyond. Reserved for one party at a time.

From $3,800,000 / night
Dining

The Selene
Table

"There are restaurants with views. And then there is this — a place where the view makes the meal feel incidental, and the meal justifies the view entirely."
— The Spectator, 2031

Beneath a dome of engineered glass, twelve covers. The menu turns with each Earth rotation — ingredients drawn from our biome gardens, supplemented by provisions carried aboard each transit vessel. No kitchen on Earth commands this view.

Wellness

The Thermal Hall

Restoration

Recalibrated

Treatments calibrated for reduced atmospheric pressure. Therapists trained in the particular physiology of long-haul space transit. The body carries the journey in ways that take time to understand. We understand them.

Hydrotherapy

The Gravity Pool

In one-sixth gravity, water moves differently. The body, too. The pool was designed around this fact. You will float here without effort and without analogy to anything you have experienced on Earth. Time here does not pass. It deepens.

The Guest Experience

From Earth to Selene

I

Departure

Your transit begins at one of six designated departure terminals — Geneva, Reykjavík, or Singapore. A dedicated flight crew. No commercial connections. No queues. The lounge at each terminal is quiet and unhurried.

II

Transit

Fifty-six hours aboard the Selene Express — a private orbital vessel with four sleeper suites, a dining car, and viewports that span the hull. Earth shrinks behind you. The quiet arrives gradually, then completely.

III

Arrival

Descent through Mare Tranquillitatis. The hotel appears below as a lit jewel on grey silence. Ground staff await at the lunar port. The air inside smells faintly of cedar and stone.

IV

Residence

The duration of your stay is measured not in nights but in Earth rotations visible from your window. There is no check-out rush. The staff have standing instructions not to mention time unless asked.

V

Return

You will be different on the return. Most guests are quiet. The transport crew understands this and does not disturb. The Selene Grand arranges re-entry assistance and onward travel at each destination terminal.

Inquiries
